added_failures_note: Derived directly from completed baseline_suite and after_suite logs in source manifest; mandated historical revisions differ from the reviewed final product. Ten historical added IDs do not imply ten final-head regressions.

assertion_review.fails_if: Removing unmeasured-gate validation emits --gate passed; dropping the row entirely fails assert rows.
Removing exit/completion/current-head/type validation passes an invalid arm, or always refusing rejects the valid-arm control.
Recomposing the measured command drops literal --land or --no-impl-change options; the input is the independent preservation target.
Omitting the gate repair fails parsing; losing --land produces False.
Normalization changes the generated command, but losing declarations in the generator changes both sides; this does not independently protect declaration content.
Filtering queued rows removes r-waiting; retaining completion violates the independent observe expectation.
Dropping the deferred row, returning it as owed, or retaining completion violates the independent expected rows/command.
Always refusing rejects dated delivery; always allowing admits the inherited report; dropping the fixture head citation fails membership.
Allowing an undated live repair leaves a settlement row or completion command.
Removing the existing discard filter returns the synthetic refused request; already passes at base.
Wrong prefix or missing/unknown Click option raises; a gate outside the independent accepted set fails membership.
Dropping every dimension row fails assert rows; --rubric node fails exclusion or Click parsing.
Losing a disposition fails cardinality; retaining node or dropping figure selector fails independent parsed expectations.
Removing synchronous validation succeeds or queues the command; unrelated refusal lacks the required diagnostic.
Restoring the unsafe offer renders --gate passed; row disappearance alone would pass, independently guarded by lines 99-100.

findings.text: non-blocking: The commitless-declaration expectation is generated by _promotion_command at line 145 and passed into normalization, so deleting --no-commit or --outcome from that composer changes both sides together and leaves this assertion green; independently parse and require those declarations before comparing preservation.
